zh: 一旦出现下降（后一个数小于前一个数），任何跨过这条边的连续段都不合法。
维护以当前元素结尾的最长非降段长度：不下降就在前一段基础上加一，下降就从 1 重新开始。
current=answer=1；对 i=1..n−1，若 a[i−1]≤a[i] 则 current 加一，否则 current=1；每步用 current 更新 answer，最后输出。
en: As soon as there is a drop (an element smaller than the one before it), no contiguous segment crossing that edge can be valid.
Maintain the length of the longest non-decreasing run ending at the current element: extend it by one when there is no drop, and restart from 1 after a drop.
Set current = answer = 1; for i = 1..n-1, if a[i-1] <= a[i] increment current, otherwise set current = 1; update answer with current at each step and print it.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Maintain the length of the non-decreasing run ending at the current element: reset it to 1 on a drop, otherwise increase it.

## Correctness

When the current value is not smaller than the previous one, it can and can only extend the previous non-decreasing tail run. When a drop occurs, no segment crossing that edge is valid, so the run must restart from the current element. The largest tail length over the whole scan covers all contiguous segments.

## Complexity

Time O(n), extra space O(1) (not counting the input).
